Your records are encrypted with the vault key, not the password, so they are not re-encrypted. The vault key is re-wrapped with the new password; your 12-word recovery kit remains valid.

• Cipher: AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption (128-bit authentication tag, a unique 12-byte IV per record, per-record GCM AAD binding).

• Key derivation: Argon2id (RFC 9106) with 64 MiB memory, 3 iterations and 1 lane, plus a random per-vault salt. Older PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600,000 rounds) envelopes are migrated to Argon2id on unlock.

• Recovery: 12-word BIP-39 phrase (128-bit entropy, checksummed), HMAC-SHA256 key verifiers, no plaintext recovery material on disk.

• Metadata: record titles, categories, tags and payloads are encrypted together inside AES-256-GCM; SQLite columns hold redacted placeholders (item type and timestamps remain as non-secret metadata).

• Client-side zero-knowledge: no network permission, no servers, Keystore-backed biometrics, FLAG_SECURE + recents screenshot suppression, and backups that leave only through a Storage Access Framework document you pick.
